Icon on glass – «The Sorrowful Mother of God»

• In icon painting on glass, the theme of the Sorrowful Mother of God belongs to Transylvania, and it is (in fact) the most frequent theme of Transylvanian iconography. The Mother of God stands with her hands joined in prayer and a tear on her cheek, while the Crucifixion of the Saviour is painted in the background.

• I painted the icon I am showing you today in our workshop, after the model by Savu Moga (Țara Făgărașului, 1877):
- above, God the Father in the triangle of the Holy Trinity, and the Holy Spirit in the form of a dove;
- Jesus crucified on the cross, with a group of cherubim beside Him;
- at the foot of the cross, the skull of Adam, and in the lower corner, the walls of Jerusalem.

• Painted on glass with tempera and gold leaf, over a drawing made with pen and ink.
Size: 21x29.7 cm (A4 format).

• The icon is available. If you would like it in your home, or would like to give it to someone dear to you, please contact me.🤍
